column1: # TITLE: Genome-wide analysis of circRNA expression profile in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) tissues and matched adjacent normal tissues
# SUMMARY: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is a common lung disorder.Recent studies have shown that circRNA plays critical roles in a myriad of biological processes and human diseases
column2: Since the roles of circRNA in NSCLC remain unknown
column3: they were investigated in the study.Our findings indicate that the expression profiles of circRNAs have changed in NSCLC as compared with normal lung
column4: and may provide novel insight into the molecular mechanism underlying the disease and potential novel diagnostic or therapeutic targets for NSCLC.
